caseNameFull: Morey, Auditor of Public Accounts of Illinois v. Doud, doing business as Bondified Systems
attorneys: Latham Castle, Attorney General of Illinois, for movants.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 352 U. S. 923.) The motion to substitute Benjamin S. Adamowski as a party appellant in the place and stead of John Gutknecht is granted.
